patch_description:
This rewrite replaces repeated matrix-cube saturation with a faster bitset-based C4-safe insertion engine. It keeps the input graph relevant by building multiple source-edge-derived scaffolds under several orderings and bounded prefixes, then augments them using safe additions.

For each candidate insertion, the algorithm explicitly checks the C4 condition: adding uv is allowed only when no current edge joins N(u) and N(v). It estimates the number of future edges blocked by the insertion using the newly created length-three paths, preferring additions that preserve future flexibility and maintain balanced degrees.

A compact elite archive is improved using bounded ruin-and-refill exchanges. High-pressure edges are temporarily deleted, banned during the first refill phase, and replaced with alternative edges where possible. Every archived candidate is explicitly validated using A @ A, and the final result has a conservative repair fallback.
